use default

use SOLUTION = (colour: LIST[string], nation: LIST[string],
                drink: LIST[string], smoke: LIST[string],
                pet: LIST[string])

permutations(items: LIST[string]) -> Pipe[LIST[string]] is
    if items.count == 0 then
        yield LIST()
    else
        for index in 0..items.count do
            let rest = LIST(items)

            rest.remove_at(index)

            for tail in permutations(rest) do
                let whole = LIST()

                whole.add(items[index])
                whole.add_range(tail)

                yield whole
            od
        od
    fi
si

arrangements(items: string[]) -> Pipe[LIST[string]] is
    yield in permutations(LIST(items))
si

house_of(row: LIST[string], value: string) -> int =>
    row.index_of(value)

together(left: LIST[string], left_value: string,
         right: LIST[string], right_value: string) -> bool =>
    house_of(left, left_value) == house_of(right, right_value)

next_to(left: LIST[string], left_value: string,
        right: LIST[string], right_value: string) -> bool =>
    (let gap = house_of(left, left_value) - house_of(right, right_value)
     gap == 1 \/ gap == -1)

colour_rows() -> Pipe[LIST[string]] =>
    arrangements(["red", "green", "white", "yellow", "blue"])
        |> filter(row => house_of(row, "green") + 1 ==
            house_of(row, "white"))

nation_rows(colour: LIST[string]) -> Pipe[LIST[string]] =>
    arrangements(["English", "Swede", "Dane", "Norwegian", "German"])
        |> filter(row =>
            house_of(row, "Norwegian") == 0 /\
            together(row, "English", colour, "red") /\
            next_to(row, "Norwegian", colour, "blue"))

drink_rows(colour: LIST[string], nation: LIST[string])
    -> Pipe[LIST[string]] =>
    arrangements(["tea", "coffee", "milk", "beer", "water"])
        |> filter(row =>
            house_of(row, "milk") == 2 /\
            together(row, "tea", nation, "Dane") /\
            together(row, "coffee", colour, "green"))

smoke_rows(colour: LIST[string], nation: LIST[string],
           drink: LIST[string]) -> Pipe[LIST[string]] =>
    arrangements(["Pall Mall", "Dunhill", "Blend", "Blue Master",
                  "Prince"])
        |> filter(row =>
            together(row, "Dunhill", colour, "yellow") /\
            together(row, "Blue Master", drink, "beer") /\
            together(row, "Prince", nation, "German") /\
            next_to(row, "Blend", drink, "water"))

pet_rows(nation: LIST[string], smoke: LIST[string])
    -> Pipe[LIST[string]] =>
    arrangements(["dog", "bird", "cat", "horse", "zebra"])
        |> filter(row =>
            together(row, "dog", nation, "Swede") /\
            together(row, "bird", smoke, "Pall Mall") /\
            next_to(row, "cat", smoke, "Blend") /\
            next_to(row, "horse", smoke, "Dunhill"))

solutions() -> Pipe[SOLUTION] is
    for colour in colour_rows() do
        for nation in nation_rows(colour) do
            for drink in drink_rows(colour, nation) do
                for smoke in smoke_rows(colour, nation, drink) do
                    for pet in pet_rows(nation, smoke) do
                        yield (colour = colour, nation = nation,
                               drink = drink, smoke = smoke, pet = pet)
                    od
                od
            od
        od
    od
si

pad(text: string, width: int) -> string =>
    if text.length >= width then
        text
    else
        pad("{text} ", width)
    fi

row_text(house: int, solution: SOLUTION) -> string =>
    "{pad("{house + 1}", 3)}{pad(solution.colour[house], 8)}"
        "{pad(solution.nation[house], 11)}"
        "{pad(solution.drink[house], 8)}"
        "{pad(solution.smoke[house], 12)}{solution.pet[house]}"

let found = solutions() |> collect_list()

write_line("{pad("no", 3)}{pad("colour", 8)}{pad("nation", 11)}"
    "{pad("drink", 8)}{pad("smoke", 12)}pet")

for solution in found do
    for house in 0..5 do
        write_line(row_text(house, solution))
    od

    write_line("the {solution.nation[house_of(solution.pet, "zebra")]}"
        " owns the zebra")
od

write_line("solutions found: {found.count}")
